message:
feat(release): version 2.0.0

- VERSION file is the single source of truth, injected into the bundle by
  vite.config.ts and written into build-meta.json by the build script
- the site shows the version in the top banner, the navbar badge and the
  footer instead of the BETA label
- the Discord bot's release announcement now includes the version
- new admin-only /announce command to publish a release notice by hand
author: BSS Index Developer
